column3: Settled just off the pace - made ground over 2f out to hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to prevail
Went straight to front early - travelled well up with the pace before regaining command over 2f out - overtaken inside the last furlong - kept on to be narrowly denied
Reserved at the back - gradual progress from 5f out to challenge for second over 1f out - unable to land a blow in the closing stages and took third
Settled off the pace towards the back - improved on the outer approaching 2f out - fourth into the final furlong and unable to close
Went straight to front early - lost command approaching final 2f - dropped away inside last furlong to finish 5th
Sluggish start - settled towards midfield - began losing touch over 2f out - finished sixth
Missed the break - stayed in touch at the tail throughout - never troubled the front and beaten home in 7th
Settled in the pack - moved forward on the outer with 5f left - dropped back and drifted left approaching 2f out - well held at the finish
Handy early - dropped away 5f out - trailed off through final 2f - finished ninth
Drifted right at the off - settled just behind the front pack - moved into second a furlong out - hit the front close home and stayed on strongly
Drifted right at the break - settled close up before going ahead over 2f out - overtaken inside the final furlong - unable to fight back through the closing stages
Settled among the pack early - improved from 2f out to move into third inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish third
Held a midfield spot - pressed for effort a furlong out and eased right approaching the final stretch - stayed on to take fourth close home
Sat close to pace - pushed along 2f out - lost ground inside final furlong - eventually finished fifth
Fidgety in the gate - hit the front early before losing command inside the final two furlongs - faded late to finish sixth
Up with the front group early - pressed for effort a furlong out then faded close home to finish seventh
Squeezed for space at the break - settled at the back and asked for effort inside final furlong - stayed off the pace throughout to finish well beaten
Settled in the pack early - lost touch approaching final furlongs - trailed home in 9th
Squeezed for space at the break - settled towards the back - began losing touch two furlongs out - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack early - dropped away with 2f left - no impact from there and trailed home in 11th
Slow to break - stayed towards the back throughout - well held in 12th
Tracked the pace in touch - hit the front inside the last furlong and a half - driven out to assert close home - held on gamely for the win
Settled towards back early - moved left and made progress 2f out - went second with a furlong left but unable to close final gap
Settled at back early - fighting the bridle through the race - squeezed for space with a furlong left - finished well to grab third close home
Handy early - hit front two out before giving way inside final furlong - held effort to finish fourth
Settled towards the back - boxed in with 2f left and forced left a furlong out - couldn't quicken and finished 5th
Settled midpack early - pushed along with a furlong left - nudged into contention late but well beaten in 6th
Missed the break badly - settled towards the back - squeezed for space with two furlongs left - darted left for room - stayed on late without threatening - finished seventh
Settled off the pace in the pack - nudged into contention over 2f out - unable to threaten those ahead - finished eighth
Poor start - settled midfield before angling left to close 1f out - lost place late to finish ninth
Sat close to the pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish well held
Set the pace early - pressed for effort and lost front spot 2f out - drifted left and dropped away inside final furlong - finished well beaten in 11th
Sat close to the front group - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish well beaten
Dwelt at the start - moved up to press the front runner - hit the front over 2f out - drew well ahead inside the final 110 yards to win with plenty in hand
Sluggish start - settled off the pace - moved left approaching 2f out - up into second inside final furlong but unable to close on winner
Slow into stride - settled towards back - stayed on late to finish third without threatening
Settled off the pace - moved into contention inside the last 2f - unable to quicken and edged out of third close home
Sent clear early - lost front spot with 2f left then dropped away inside final 2f - allowed to finish steadily in 5th
Set the pace from the off - drifted right approaching the bend 3f out - pushed along inside the final furlong to hold on for the win
Sluggish start - stayed in touch with front group - moved into second spot 3f out - drifted left approaching final furlong then outpaced late for second
Raced handy on the outer - pushed along with 3f left - stayed on into third once headway of leaders stalled
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - made progress over 2f out before shifting left to move into fourth inside the final furlong - unable to close on the front-runners late
Sluggish start - settled near back and improved into contention 2f out - held fifth without further progress from 1f out
Held up towards the back - squeezed for space with 2f left - couldn't get into contention - finished sixth
Tracked the front group early - drifted markedly left and dropped away with 2f left - well held at the finish
Handy early - pushed along with over 2f left - dropped away soon after - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - pushed along under pressure with 3f left - fell away out of contention thereafter
Set the pace from the start - pressed for effort with two furlongs left - powered away inside the final furlong - drew away comfortably to score
Sat just behind the front-runner - roused along with two furlongs left and edged away from the pack before challenging strongly inside the last - narrowly denied at the line for second
Held up eagerly early - up with the pace - pushed along over 2f out and unable to match front-runners - stayed on same pace late to finish third
Held up with a firm grip behind the front group - pushed along approaching final 2f and stayed on through the last furlong - weakened close home
Held up mid-pack - pressed for effort with 3f left - kept on inside the closing furlong - finished fifth
Settled towards the back of the pack - urged along with 3f left - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish 6th

Held up eagerly in the pack - pressed for effort with 3f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 8th
Held up at back of field - stayed there through the race - never a factor - finished eighth
Held up early holding a strong grip - always off the pace - no impression made late - finished tenth
Held up at the back throughout - never got competitive - well beaten in 11th
Slow to break - settled midfield - urged into 4th spot with two furlongs left - into 3rd a furlong out - hit the front inside final furlong - kept going for clear win
Sat close up in second early - shared front spot two out and pressed for effort - overtaken inside final furlong - held on for the runner-up spot without threatening the winner
Went straight to front - driven and reeled in with 2f left - lost command inside final furlong to sit 3rd - couldn't find more finishing 3rd beaten 4 lengths
Held a midfield position early - urged into 6th over 2f from home and still there with a furlong left - finished with a steady late effort to take 4th at the line
Sat close to the pace early - pushed into 3rd two out - slipped back to 5th final furlong holding on for nothing more
Sat close to the pace early - fighting for control in the process - pushed along in 5th two out - up to 4th final furlong but unable to threaten
Hesitant start and settled last - urged into contention 2f out - still down in 9th with a furlong left - stayed on same gear to finish 7th
Held up at the back - driven from over 2f out - unable to make headway late
Sat close to front group early - urged along by halfway - dropped away thereafter - finished ninth
Hesitant start - settled at back of field - driven to chase 2f out - eighth and unable to close 1f out - well held at finish
Held up at the back - unable to make an impression - well held in 11th
Set the pace from the off - pushed along with over two furlongs left - stayed on strongly to the line unchallenged
Slow into stride - improved to share second by 2f - opened up in second spot 4f out - pressed on late but never troubling the runaway leader - held on for second
Held up at the rear early travelling with enthusiasm - pushed along to make ground 3f out - unable to match the leading two from 2f out and well held at the finish
Sat close to leader early - shared second briefly before slipping to third with 4f left - began to weaken - allowed to finish steadily late
Held up towards back - improved through field - won race
Settled in the pack away from the rail - moved across and improved position from 2f out - hit the front inside the final furlong - kept going but had nothing more and was caught right at the line
held up towards the back - driven approaching the final furlong - progress close home to grab third place
Held up on the near flank early - made ground into contention by halfway - pushed along a furlong out and drifted left approaching the final furlong - gave way late to finish fourth
Went clear far rail - dropped back under pressure inside final furlong - stayed on same pace to finish fifth
Held up towards back on the far flank - progress from inside final two furlongs to close on pace-setters - couldn't quicken again and held for sixth
Urged up from the back on the near flank early - made progress towards the middle of the track from 1f out - plugged on at one tempo to finish 7th
Towards the rear on the stands' rail - pressed to front of that pack approaching the final furlong before collared and left behind - faded rapidly in the closing stages to finish 8th
Raced handily on the far rail - shared front spot inside final 2f before fading through the last furlong - dropped away towards the line
Struck the front on the near rail - dropped away under pressure over 2f out - faded rapidly inside the final furlong to finish 10th
Held up towards the back - short of space with a furlong left - finished hard once clear inside the last - got up right on the line
Handy with the front group early - asked for effort 2f out - lost ground inside final furlong and faded to finish 12th
Handy with front group down the far straight - driven up in pursuit approaching final furlong - lost momentum inside final 110 yards
Handy with pace on the far rail early - lost ground under pressure 2f out and dropped away - well beaten through the last furlong
Settled towards the back early - made ground on the inner approaching final 2f - hit the front with a furlong left - kept finding under pressure to score
Settled towards the back of the pack early - improved into contention wide out from 2f out - moved into second inside the final furlong but couldn't threaten the winner - stayed on to the line
Went straight to front - pushed along and overtaken with about a furlong left - dropped to third close home - finished without further response
Settled off the pace midfield - travelling nicely with 2f remaining - short of room when finding extra a furlong out - moved into fourth close home but couldn't threaten those ahead
Drifted right at the outset - sat behind the front pack and pushed along with 2f left - lost ground close home
Held a forward position early - pressed for effort with 2f left and slipped back from second - dropped away in the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled in the pack - improved out wide before 2f out then pressed for effort - faded quickly and finished 7th
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - finished well held in 8th
Squeezed for space at the break - sat handy on the rails - dropped away with two furlongs left - eventually finished ninth
Sat close to the pace early - dropped away with 5f left - trailed home in the closing stages
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - boxed in approaching two out before finding room - pushed to the front inside final furlong and stayed on strongly to win
Settled off the pace in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - moved into second entering the final furlong and stayed on well but couldn't get to the winner
Settled in the pack - pushed along to join the front two furlongs out before losing that spot and fading entering the last - found renewed effort to grab third close home
Sluggish start - settled at the back - travelling fine turning into the straight with 2f left - asked for effort soon after - stayed on late to finish fourth without threatening the front
Settled in the pack early - still close up with two furlongs left and pushed along with a real shout turning in - lost momentum near the line to finish fifth
Pulling hard early - went to front - challenged and driven along 2f out then overtaken approaching final furlong - faded quickly after finishing 6th
Handy in the pack early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away in the closing furlong to finish seventh
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - urged forward with 3f left - checked and steered left 2f out then edged closer in the straight to finish well beaten
Settled in the pack early - pressed for room and driven along over 2f out then dropped away - unable to make headway late finished ninth
Handy with the front group early - pressed for effort before 2f out and dropped away - faded to finish tenth
Dwelt at the start - up with the front group - nudged along 3f out - faded from 2f out and finished a well-beaten 11th
Held a midfield position early - asked for effort 3f out and up to 5th with 2f left - moved into 3rd a furlong out - swept to the front inside the final furlong and kept finding more to win
Sat just behind the front group - pressed for effort 2f out in 3rd - went in front a furlong out - overtaken close home and held on for the runner-up spot
Held up towards the back on the wide side - driven approaching final 2f then made ground into 5th with a furlong left - stayed on late to finish 3rd

Missed the break - settled in the middle order - under pressure in 8th approaching the 2f marker - made some progress to 7th inside the final furlong - stuck on but never troubled the front rank to finish 4th
Sluggish start - settled towards the back of the pack - unable to make headway in the closing stages
Settled towards midfield wide - moved into 4th 2f out and pressed for effort - held that position inside final furlong - unable to find more late and finished 6th

Held up in midfield - pushed along in 9th with 2f left - unable to close - eventually finished 8th

Held up towards the back - failed to threaten in the closing stages - finished well held in 10th
Settled midfield in the early stages - unable to make headway in the closing stages - well held in 11th
Held up towards the back - unable to build momentum in the straight - well held in 12th
Poor start - stayed at the rear throughout - well held in 13th
Set the pace early - pressed for effort with two furlongs left before losing command soon after - faded late finishing well beaten
Slow to muster interest early - remained at rear throughout - no impression made on leaders - finished well beaten in 15th

Went straight to the front - pushed along with 2f left and lost the advantage inside the final furlong - faded quickly to finish fifth
Settled with plenty of enthusiasm mid-pack - pushed along with 2f left but couldn't close on the front group - stayed on down the inner in the closing stages to finish sixth

Held a spot near the front - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - eventually beaten home
Urged forward early - fighting the bridle - sat in second - pressed for effort 2f out then dropped away final furlong - finished tenth
Sluggish start at the back - failed to get involved - well held throughout - finished 11th
Raced up with the pace - pushed along over 2f out - lost ground final furlong to finish 12th
Sat wide in the pack - pushed along a furlong out but found little - dropped away and finished well beaten

Raced handy on the near rail - driven to close on the front pair over a furlong out - stayed on to snatch second close home
Handy with the front group down the far rail - well placed entering final furlong - stayed on without finding more close home - third beaten a length and a quarter

Tardy start - settled towards the back on the far flank - made ground from 2f out - pushed up to challenge the front group 1f out - edged left in the closing stages and found little
Held up early - progress into contention late - stayed on final furlong to finish 7th
settled midpack early - closed on the front group with 2f left - pressed for effort inside final furlong - drifted left and lost momentum close home to finish eighth
Handy near the pace on the near rail - asked for effort 2f out but found little - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 9th
Held mid-pack near the stand rail early - lost touch with the pace two furlongs out - gave way inside the final furlong to finish 10th
Held handy on the near flank early - pressed for effort with 2f left then found little a furlong out - faded quickly through the closing stages

Settled at back of field - asked for effort 3f out - made progress into final furlong - stayed on well to finish sixth beaten 3 lengths

settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 3f left - still in contention then angled right approaching the final furlong - stayed on at one gait to finish ninth
Settled towards the rear early and travelled erratically under pressure - niggled along in the pack - nudged into contention briefly a furlong out - then faded to finish tenth
Erratic in the early running - settled towards the back - nudged into contention passing the final furlong - eventually well beaten in 11th
Fought for control early - up with pace before being pushed along and slipping back 2f out - faded quickly to finish well held
Handy in early stages - pressed for effort and dropped away 2f out - soon well held
Held up rear from the off - never involved - well beaten in 14th
Held up towards the back - driven into contention 2f out into 6th - pressed on into 3rd inside the final furlong - hit the front close home and kept going to win
Midfield - urged forward from 9th 2f out - kept on strongly through the final furlong to grab 2nd close home - just denied
Sent to front early - fighting for control - pressed for effort with 2f left - overtaken shortly after - held on steadily to finish 3rd close up

Held up at the back - shaken up to move into 8th two out then 7th approaching the final furlong - stayed on late but never a factor for the finish
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along in 4th two out - unable to close the gap late - finished 6th beaten 4 lengths
Slow to break - held towards the back - urged forward with a furlong left and shown the whip in 11th - stayed on to the line finishing 7th
Sat close to the front group early - pressed for effort in 7th with 2f left - unable to close the gap - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away late finishing 9th

Settled in the pack - unable to find headway inside final 2f - dropped away late to finish 11th

Tracked the pace close up - pushed along with 2f left - hit the front a furlong out - caught close home for second by a short head
Missed the break - settled towards the back - push along 2f out - made progress and angled left inside the final furlong - stayed on to claim third
Handy in the pack early - pushed along with 2f left - kept on inside the final furlong to finish 4th
Restless in the back half of the field - pushed along 2f out - angled left over 1f out - made some ground on fading horses inside the final furlong before running out of momentum
Held a forward position early - pushed along with over 2f left - kept going without finding extra in the closing stages - finished sixth
Pushed at rear from 2f - moved left and made progress over 2f out - effort flattened out inside final furlong to finish 7th
Set the pace early - pushed along and lost command with over two furlongs left - dropped away final furlong to finish eighth
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished ninth
Held mid-pack early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong - finished well beaten in 10th
Racing near the pace early - pushed along with 3f left and soon losing touch with the leaders - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish well held
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort 3f out then lost touch inside final 2f - dropped away late to finish well held

Handy early holding a spot towards the middle of the track - hit the front soon after and dictated in unhurried fashion - picked up the tempo approaching 2f out - opened a healthy advantage inside the last furlong - margin shortened near the line but never in danger - held on to score

Held up in the pack - going nicely though short of space with 2f left - found gap and moved into second inside the final furlong with strong headway - driven out under pressure close home to finish second

Held mid-pack early - short of space and driven approaching 2f out - eased across and closed on front group with a furlong left - moved into third close home - fought for second in the final stretch but had nothing more left - held on for third
Held up towards the back - driven to improve inside the last furlong - moved into fourth close home - stayed on to the line
Settled in the pack - asked for effort with 2f left - lost ground close home

Took a strong hold and went straight to the front - soon overtaken and tracked in the chase for second - asked for effort inside final 3f - drifted about under pressure approaching the last furlong - faded late and slipped a place close to home
Held up towards the back - moved through to challenge the front group 3f out before losing touch 2f out - stayed on same effort late to finish 7th
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left before losing ground inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish eighth
Sat close to the pace wide of rivals early - moved into third - asked for effort and lost ground 2f out - eased back through the field last furlong to finish 9th
Settled towards the back early - lost touch and toiling with 4f left - never able to threaten the front-runners - finished well beaten in 10th
Settled towards back of the pack - travelling strongly with 2f left - moved through gap to the outside and gained ground - hit the front a furlong out - opened a advantage and idled home in front

Settled just behind the pace - squeezed for space entering the straight - boxed in briefly with a furlong left - shifted right to find room - finished strongly to grab second but couldn't reel in winner
Settled just off the pace early - made ground into it 2f out - hit the front briefly a furlong out before being overtaken - dropped back to third close home
Went straight to front early - pushed along and lost command inside final furlong - unable to peg back winner in closing stages - held for fourth
Held a spot near the front - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground and dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 5th beaten 4 lengths
Fought for control early - travelled close up on the rail - pressed for effort a furlong out and faded near the line
Settled towards the back of the pack - asked for effort with 2f remaining - no impact on finish - eventually beaten well into 7th
Settled at the rear early - nudged for effort with 2f remaining - no real threat to leaders - finished eighth
Held up in the pack - pushed along with two furlongs left - dropped away out wide inside the final furlong - finished 9th
Held up at the back throughout - never able to challenge - finished well held in 10th
Handy early - pressed for the front outside 2f - close up entering last furlong - stayed on to win in final strides
Sent to front early - travelling comfortably 2f out - pressed for effort and advantage narrowed inside final furlong - caught close home to finish second
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort 2f out - moved into third inside the final furlong - stayed on well to finish third

Held up handy in the pack - pushed along and slipped back into fourth over 2f out then eased further behind inside the final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish fifth
Fought for control early - settled towards back - pushed along to close ground 2f out then faded close home
Erratic pace through midpack - stayed on briefly inside final furlong - then dropped away to finish seventh
Sluggish start leaving to settle at the back - pushed along with 3f left - nudged closer late but well beaten in 8th
Fought for control early - settled midpack before pressed for effort with 3f left - faded inside final furlong to finish well beaten
Pulled hard early - settled midpack - pressed for effort with 3f left - faded inside final furlong to finish well beaten
Held a spot around mid-pack early - pressed for effort with over 2f left - dropped away soon after and finished well held

Never a factor - well held throughout - finished 13th
Sat behind the front pack - urged into 4th with two out - hit the front late to score
Settled in 2nd - moved to the front 2 1/2f out - challenged hard inside the final furlong - overtaken near the line and had nothing left to give

Sat close to front pack - pushed along into 3rd with 2f left - unable to gain further headway thereafter - finished 6th
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along in 6th approaching the final 2f - unable to close the gap - finished well held in 7th
Held up towards the back - improved into 5th and pressed for effort 2f out - faded through the finish to end well beaten
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away late to finish ninth

Held up behind pair towards the back - pushed along to challenge for the front inside final furlong - unable to find more and held for third
mid-pack early - urged forward after halfway and asked for effort a furlong out - stayed on to grab fourth close home

mid-pack on the far flank - pushed along a furlong out - faded inside the closing furlong to finish seventh
Sent clear in front - pressed for the lead entering the last furlong - dropped away rapidly close home - eventually beaten well into eighth

Tracked front group early - dropped away approaching 3f out - trailed home in the closing stages - finished 5th
missed the start - detached throughout - a distant 6th
Handy early - shared front with rival before nudged along 2f out then went clear inside final furlong - stayed on strongly for the win
